why: Five separate features, a database migration and an admin page in one task, with the whole source tree in scope. Several criteria leave the essentials open: how long links last, what the rate limit is, what "recent" means. It should be split, and the rubric asks whether a task is small enough for one piece of work.

task.summary: Overhaul signup: validate usernames, add email verification with expiring links, rate-limit signups per IP, add an admin page listing recent signups, and migrate the users table to add verified_at and signup_ip.

story.role: a support agent investigating accounts that cannot be found by name
story.benefit: no more accounts are created that nobody can search for or sign in to

impactedAreas.impact: Receives a new 422 error with code "username_required". It already shows the message field of 422 errors, so no change is needed, but the web team should confirm the wording.
Same new error. Versions before 4.2 show a generic failure for unknown error codes, which is acceptable.
Not changed by this task. Cleaning them up is separate work.

acceptance.behavior: Blank usernames are rejected with 422 username_required.
acceptance.gherkin:
Given a signup request with username ""
When it is sent to POST /signup
Then the response status is 422 and the error code is "username_required"

acceptance.behavior: New users must verify their email before signing in.
acceptance.gherkin:
Given a newly signed-up user
When they try to sign in before clicking the link in the verification email
Then sign-in is refused

Given many signups from one IP address
When the limit is exceeded
Then further signups are refused for a while

Given an admin user
When they open the signups page
Then they see recent signups

testCases.description: A user who has not verified cannot sign in; after verifying they can.
The eleventh signup from one IP in a minute is refused.
The admin page lists the last signups.

scenarios.omitted: Hidden scenarios are not implemented yet.

nonGoals: Rules about which characters a username may contain, or its length
Fixing accounts already created with blank usernames
Changing the error format of other endpoints

concerns: Touches authentication and a database migration

reuse: The validationError(code, message) helper in src/errors.js, which already produces the 422 error shape used by the email and password checks
task.approach: Add the check at the top of the handler, before the existing validation, using the existing validationError helper.
